```python

| Action | Why It Matters | How To Do It |
|--------|-----------------|--------------|
| **Confirm Availability** | Flights fill up fast, especially in business class. | Check the airline’s website or app for seats on 10/10. |

|----------|--------|
| **Do I need to pay upfront?** | Most airlines require full prepayment at booking, though some allow partial deposits. |
| **Can I change dates later?** | Yes, but fees apply. Booking early locks in lower rates. |
